svg.title: A deleted record becomes an address
svg.desc: Four 85-byte slots follow an eight-byte header. Delete RRN 1, then RRN 3, and the header points to 3, which links to 1, then minus one. Insert overwrites RRN 3 and advances the head to 1, without growing the file. Labels use outlined Noto Sans.

g.aria-label: A deleted record becomes an address
g.title: A deleted record becomes an address

g.aria-label: Relative record numbers identify fixed slots; the file header anchors a persistent free chain.
g.title: Relative record numbers identify fixed slots; the file header anchors a persistent free chain.

g.aria-label: Read next = 1 › overwrite slot 3 › set live_count = 3, free_head = 1
g.title: Read next = 1 › overwrite slot 3 › set live_count = 3, free_head = 1

g.aria-label: 750 surviving records stayed unchanged. Use insert after deletion; legacy append can overwrite a live slot.
g.title: 750 surviving records stayed unchanged. Use insert after deletion; legacy append can overwrite a live slot.
